Subject: Joiner/offboarding provenance request — SCIM delta & SAML samples

Vanessa —

As part of Medisys's SOC 2 intake for Q2 we need a provenance package showing how joiners and offboards were handled for the last quarter. Specifically we need: 

- SCIM delta extracts (creation/modify/deactivate) for the window 2026-01-01 to 2026-04-30, with attribute diffs.
- Representative SAML assertion samples for a normal user login and one service-account SAML flow.
- Proof of offboard trigger (deprovision event) + timestamped action (who/what).
- JIT/ephemeral admin approval logs for any privileged elevation during that period.
- A short note on redaction guidance for shared artifacts (what fields can be redacted and why).

Can you confirm you can provide these artifacts, any constraints on delivery format, and an estimated delivery date? HubSpot record: https://hubspot.com/contacts/medisys-12345

Thanks,
Sheila Park
Compliance Manager — Medisys

Deliverables (single ZIP):
- provenance_manifest.csv (index of items + extraction queries)

If that timeline works I will kick off extraction with Marcus and have Sean run the redaction guidance review.

Best,

Adding technical details for the extraction so expectations are aligned:

- SCIM delta: we will produce CSV with columns: action (create/modify/deactivate), timestamp (UTC), actor (service_account or idp-provisioner), target_type (user/service_account), external_id (opaque), attrs_before (JSON string), attrs_after (JSON string), source (SCIM/API/Manual). Sample rows are in scim_delta_extract_*.csv attachment.
- Time window: inclusive 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z -> 2026-04-30T23:59:59Z.
- Service accounts: we will tag target_type=service_account; separate file for service-account entitlement snapshots (service_account_entitlements_20260430.csv).
- SAML assertions: we will pull 5 representative assertions (interactive user, SSO from Okta, SSO from Azure AD, service-account assertion, and one failed assertion for context). We will blank out NameID by default; can provide a mapping if you need to match to your internal IDs.
- JIT admin flows: we capture approval ID, requester, approver, requested scope, token TTL, justification, and audit timestamp.

Location for large extracts (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdeExample (I will drop the ZIP there).

Attachments: scim_delta_extract_20260101-20260430.csv (sample), saml_assertion_sample_20260415.xml, service_account_entitlements_20260430.csv

—Marcus
Principal Systems Engineer, Runtime & Provisioning
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the plan. A couple of clarifying asks before you drop the ZIP: 

1) For service accounts, can you include the last activity timestamp and the owner (if available)? We need to show justification for existing service accounts.
2) Retention: confirm whether the SCIM change history is retained beyond 12 months or if some events were compacted/archived for the period requested.
3) Redaction: please indicate which fields you will redact by default (we prefer hashes for email / unique identifiers).

Also, for JIT logs we need the approval chain (who approved upstream) — if approvals flow through delegated approvers please include the chain. If any of these require additional authorization from your side let us know the E2E request ID so we can track.

Regards,
Liam O'Connor
Lead Auditor — RTS Audit
(Attachment: audit_questions.pdf)

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>

Liam / Sheila —

Good questions — quick answers: 

1) Service accounts: we will include last_activity_ts and owner_id (if present in metadata). Where owner is missing we will flag it as "orphaned" in the manifest.
2) Retention: our SCIM change events are retained in hot storage for 18 months; nothing in the 2026-01 -> 2026-04 window has been compacted. We will note this in redaction_guidance.md.
3) Redaction defaults: PII (email, phone) will be hashed with a HMAC-SHA256 salt; NameIDs in SAML will be blanked unless you request mapping. We will supply the mapping table under controlled access only.

We will include the approval chain for JIT entries (approver list + timestamps). ETA unchanged: 2026-05-08 EOD PT. I will upload the ZIP to the Drive link Marcus shared and send a DocuSign link for an access agreement if you request full mapping tables.

-Vanessa
Senior Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
(Attachments: workback_plan.xlsx, redaction_guidance.md)
